head: 82fef4a22503dd3affdd39e7120b6f71e9423f86

source.ref: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/22744; AACR-Bench dataset.json row 40 (claim), rows 1534 and 1535 (forbid seeds); hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; merged upstream as eea9f81a90, and main still writes "\n" to std::cerr and keeps the resolver in these lines

rationale:
A cleanup of ParameterManager::LoadDocument: unique_ptr instead of new/delete, a no-op entity resolver, and "
" instead of std::endl on std::cerr. No in-contract defect was found in the change, so the case is forbid-only. Row 40 (a person's comment that "
" delays error output) is retired as false at head: std::cerr is unit-buffered, so each insertion flushes, also after MainGui swaps its streambuf (rdbuf() leaves the flags), and upstream kept "
"; as with lvgl in ADR-0036, its range becomes a forbid range. Seed 1535 (the resolver may silently not block entities through a wrong signature) is false: override on the pure virtual SAX resolveEntity makes a mismatch a compile error, and with setDisableDefaultEntityResolution(true) Xerces resolves nothing when the resolver returns null, so it forbids the resolver and where it is installed. Seed 1534 praises make_unique and states no defect, so it adds no range. Licence: the root LICENSE is the LGPL v2 text and the touched files' headers say version 2 or any later version.

forbid.reason: The resolver overrides the SAX resolveEntity signature exactly (override would not compile otherwise), and with default entity resolution disabled a null return resolves nothing, so external entities stay blocked.
Default entity resolution is disabled before the no-op resolver is installed, so no external entity is fetched, whatever the resolver returns.
std::cerr is unit-buffered, so writing "\n" instead of std::endl flushes the error message just as soon; nothing is delayed or lost.
